# Diana & Lavendar Lewis

- [Diana](../character/diana.md) — Friend of — [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) — frequent visitors who brought joy to her life · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolhouse antics and comforting [Dora](../character/dora.md) after [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scares her with stories of her deceased relatives. Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) take a walk through the woods and accidentally lose their way while heading to a tea party. Their wrong turn leads them to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), where they meet the eccentric Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young maid, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), who invite them to stay for a pretend tea party.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) enjoy tea with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young servant, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), in her house and garden. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) demonstrates the garden's magical echoes and explains how all her young helpers ended up named [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md). Before the girls leave, [Anne](../character/anne.md) accidentally mentions [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), which briefly brings a subtle change and quiet sadness over Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) as they say goodbye.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) walks to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to visit Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and they spend an enjoyable evening sharing stories, tea, and candy. Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) opens up about her past romance and broken engagement with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to suggest bringing his son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), for a visit. A month later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) introduces [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) to Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), and the two quickly form a warm and fond connection.
>
> — v2 · XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance

> [Diana](../character/diana.md) expresses sadness about [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leaving for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) and asks [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her romantic feelings for [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). [Anne](../character/anne.md) clarifies that [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is strictly a friend and describes her idealized view of love. The two girls discuss local gossip regarding [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md) and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) before reaffirming their deep, lifelong affection for each other.
>
> — v2 · XXVI Around the Bend

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) spends a busy month helping Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for her upcoming wedding and discusses the romantic turn of events with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne.md) stumbles upon [Diana Barry](../character/di.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) professing their love for each other in the [Barry](../character/barry.md) garden. The next evening, [Diana](../character/diana.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to tell [Anne](../character/anne.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reflect on love and her own imagined future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

> [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) visit [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) to help [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md) and Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) prepare for the upcoming wedding. The next day, Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) are married in the garden in front of their guests, after which everyone sees them off at the station. While locking up the stone house afterward, [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a quiet, poignant moment that subtly alters the nature of their relationship as they look toward their college years.
>
> — v2 · XXX A Wedding at the Stone House
